current_step: ISCF-SPS Step7A local implementation and contract audit
user_direction: freeze ISCF multi-scope architecture and study stronger arm specialization/utilization
problem: ISCF independent history maps are effective, but a shared unrestricted target synthesis lets nominally different scope arms remain functionally substitutable and weakens scope-specific gradient allocation.
idea: Project every arm forecast onto a scope-native local interpolation subspace before the existing target-wise fusion, so the forward role and backward error spectrum are tied to that arm's output-coupling extent.

split_roles.validation: checkpoint selection and first effectiveness/specialization screen
split_roles.test: disabled until a separately frozen complete matrix and explicit authorization

rollback: If the local contract fails, return Step5/6. If validation performance or specialization is not better than parent/global controls, reject exact SPS-v0 and return Step4 without adding a loss, router, or per-dataset tuning.
